recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中早期紅血球母細胞（深藍細胞質）與另一顆前驅細胞的細胞質內有多個清楚的空泡，旁邊中性球分葉異常；早期前驅細胞出現細胞質空泡、再加上神經病變與腸胃症狀，應想到銅缺乏（copper deficiency）這個不常見的貧血原因。
features: Early erythroid precursor (proerythroblast) with deeply basophilic cytoplasm and discrete small cytoplasmic vacuoles (panel A)
Larger precursor with gray-blue cytoplasm containing multiple clear vacuoles (panel B)
Nearby neutrophils with abnormal/hypolobated nuclear segmentation
Scattered extracellular pink-red granular material in the background of panel A
describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smears show early erythroid and myeloid precursors containing multiple discrete cytoplasmic vacuoles, including a proerythroblast with intensely basophilic, vacuolated cytoplasm. Adjacent neutrophils show abnormal nuclear segmentation. Ring sideroblast assessment is not possible without an iron stain. In a patient with neuropathy and gastrointestinal symptoms, vacuolization of early hematopoietic precursors raises copper deficiency (e.g. from malabsorption or zinc excess) as the cause of anemia; serum copper and ceruloplasmin should be measured.

ddx.vs: MDS shows dysplasia with clonal cytogenetic abnormalities and does not reverse, whereas copper-deficiency vacuoles and dyspoiesis resolve with copper repletion.
Ethanol also vacuolates early precursors; history and normal serum copper/ceruloplasmin distinguish it.
Drug-induced precursor vacuolation is morphologically identical and requires medication history.
Erythroid leukemia shows sheets of vacuolated proerythroblasts (>=30% of cells) with marked atypia rather than scattered vacuolated precursors.
